title: Token Contract Must Reference the Correct IdentityRegistry
desc: Token.identityRegistry() must equal deployed IdentityRegistry address

title: IdentityRegistry Must Link Properly to the ClaimTopicsRegistry
Compliance Contract Must Be Bound and Linked Back to Token
desc: Token.compliance() nonzero and bound back to token

title: Compliance Hooks Must Be Invoked in Token Operations
desc: Token should call compliance.canTransfer/created/etc in its logic

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry Must Support Topic Management Functions
KYC Identity Verification Must Be Enforced Before Token Transfers
desc: Must verify true identity before allowing value transfer (align HKMA CDD obligations)

title: Transaction Record-Keeping Must Meet HKMA AML Obligations
desc: Must maintain auditable logs per AML / HKMA record-keeping rules

title: Client Identity Verification Must Comply with SFC Code of Conduct §5.4
desc: Under SFC Code §5.4, must satisfy “reasonable grounds” for client identity before trade / transfer

title: Account Opening Procedures Must Follow SFC Approved Verification Methods
desc: Client identity verification via acceptable methods (face-to-face, certified, etc) per SFC guidelines

title: Client Identity Information Must Be Readily Available to Regulators on Request
desc: Per SFC policy, client identity info must be made available to regulators within 2 business days
